memory_update.text: PDFS should remain the highest-priority underfollowed candidate for this node because its public disclosures directly map to semiconductor manufacturing data, analytics, MES-adjacent integration, inspection, and fab collaboration software.

PCOR is a plausible second-order AI data-center construction-execution software candidate, but the thesis requires hard evidence of data-center vertical contribution or hyperscale/EPC customer traction before promotion beyond Layer 1.

BSY offers a relatively pure infrastructure engineering/digital-twin software mapping to AI data centers and grid projects, but its larger market cap and broader infrastructure mix reduce underfollowed alpha unless data-center-specific traction is strong.
ITRI is an adjacent grid-software/grid-edge automation candidate where the hidden issue is mix shift from hardware metering to recurring software, analytics, and utility control-center workflows.

Layer 1C should specifically search for smaller US-listed or ADR industrial/MES/fab-automation software vendors, utility work-management software, data-center commissioning/testing software, and public subsidiaries/spinouts that may be more obscure than PCOR/BSY/ITRI.

node: Automation and industrial software embedded in semiconductor fabs, data centers, utilities, and regulated manufacturing
summary: Layer 1B expanded the automation/industrial-software node into four US-listed candidates. The most node-pure underfollowed name is PDF Solutions, whose semiconductor manufacturing data, analytics, and automation products map directly to fab/process/test/assembly complexity. Procore and Bentley map to the construction, digital-twin, and project-execution layer of AI data center buildouts; their exposure is second-order and must be verified through data-center customer mix rather than generic construction/infrastructure growth. Itron maps to grid-edge intelligence, utility software, and asset/data management, making it an adjacent beneficiary of grid modernization driven partly by AI/data-center electricity load. No candidate is a buy/sell recommendation; all are research candidates requiring later evidence checks.
